title: Sambandhasiddhi — Proof of Relation
author: Utpaladeva
text:
The Sambandhasiddhi is the third and final member of Utpaladeva's Siddhitrayi, completing in tenth-century Kashmir the trilogy that first established the Lord, then the non-insentient subject, and now relation itself. For without genuine relation — between word and meaning, cause and effect, sign and signified, self and world — no knowledge is possible at all; and the work's method is first to refuse the counterfeits of relation offered by rival schools, then to establish the true one on grounds they cannot supply.

Its juice: relation is the quiet hinge of the whole system. Utpaladeva shows that every rival account of 'between' dissolves under pressure, while the recognition school's — grounded in the Lord's self-relation as both ground and known — holds. The trilogy ends here because once relation stands, the world of knowledge stands with it.
